text:
Alex: Quick flag: while updating the migration guide I noticed lots of inconsistent casing across snippets and headings. It's making automated checks flaky (and translators hit the abbreviations problem).
Mei: Yep. Examples: `Redwood-Private` vs `Redwood Private`, `model_id` vs `modelId`. Small but everywhere.
Luca: Proposal: unify to these defaults: product names in Title Case (no hyphens), API/SDK parameter names camelCase, CLI flags and filenames kebab-case, JSON payload keys camelCase.
Priya: Also add a rule: avoid short abbreviations in headings (e.g., "Model version" not "Model v.")  translators requested that.
Alex: I'll draft a short page in docs/style about this and include a migration snippet showing legacy vs new param names:
```json
{ "legacy": { "model_id": "rw-alpha" }, "new": { "modelId": "rw-alpha" } }
```
Mei: Can we add a CONTRIBUTING note to ask reviewers to grep for `model_id`? That saved me earlier.
Luca: I'll add a Danger rule to warn when a PR touches > 4 files with mixed-casing. If it's noisy we can relax it.
Priya: Also FYI I found two links that broke after an anchor rename. I'll paste them on the PR comment thread.
docs-bot: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1342 opened by Alex  "style: casing and migration snippet"
Alex: Targeting merge by Thursday so we can run a global sweep Friday. Please review when you can.
Mei: Reviewing now.
Luca: I'll run the snippet linter post-merge and post fixes here.
Priya: LGTM on quick skim.
